summary: Chhukha district is overwhelmingly dominated by forest cover, with 1668.14 km² (88.5%) of its land area classified as forest. The remaining land is largely agricultural, comprising 87.78 km² (4.7%) of agriculture land, followed by shrubland at 76.26 km² (4.0%) and smaller patches of meadows, alpine scrub, and water bodies. Built‑up and other land‑use types occupy less than 1 % of the district, with built‑up areas covering 6.72 km² (0.4%) and the remainder distributed among sandy banks, landslides, and minor categories.
